key_decisions: GTK3 CHAIN VERIFIED ON VM (2026-10-29, user-confirmed on eog+zim): (1) gtk-theme-name=adw-gtk3-dark when installed — Adwaita GTK3 files are absent on target systems and the stock/unstyled fallback ignores palette colors (the "Default" theme has only gtk-keys.css, a visual no-op); (2) GTK css files MUST use a /* */ marker comment — a leading # line is parsed as an id selector and GTK discards the whole stylesheet (this invalidated the earlier attempt); (3) css wrapper = @import of the shell dank-colors.css + legacy theme_* aliases + control restyle; (4) eog canvas comes from org.gnome.eog.view background-color (its own GSettings, official since 2010) — new eog target sets it via the session-bus runner; (5) environment knowledge (NOT code): quickshell/nix stubs inject QT_PLUGIN_PATH into DMS children breaking Alpine Qt6 apps (workaround = desktop Exec overrides env -u QT_PLUGIN_PATH, done live for kdenlive/ksystemlog/okular), and a nix GIO_EXTRA_MODULES dconf module breaks dconf reads for processes launched from NOIX VSCodium terminals (alacritty/DMS/niri clean).

GTK3 PALETTE + KDE/QA FINDINGS (2026-10-29, test-VM diagnosis): (1) GTK3 on the test VM ignores settings.ini entirely (proved with a distinctive value) — the only effective channel is gtk.css; gtk.css is now an Ursine-owned WRAPPER that @imports the shell dank-colors.css (shell file untouched, keeps live regeneration) and adds GTK3 legacy theme_* aliases + control restyle; zim/eog/firewall-config/galculator chrome get the palette through it. (2) kdenlive/ksystemlog crash is NOT Ursine: the nix dms wrapper exports QT_PLUGIN_PATH (nix Qt6) + QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=gtk3 into its process tree; alpine /usr/bin Qt apps then load ABI-mixed plugins (SIGABRT). Proven: env-cleaned kdenlive runs. Works from a login terminal; durable fix belongs to the DMS/nix launcher, not Ursine. (3) zim darkness = its own prefer-dark preference; bitwarden = flatpak Electron (documented non-configurable); galculator display colors revert while the app is open (saves config on exit) — Apply after closing fixes it.
